text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: paging on-call: routing.health - region fallback loop detected between us-east <-> us-west <-> eu (alerts: 3). Please ack with ETA.

Alice K: acked. noticed repeated 503 spikes starting ~1793504000. dashboards show healthy endpoints flipping between regions every 20-40s.

Alice K: stack traces show KV cache misses + model-variant mismatch logs when routing hops. suspect policy bounce + aggressive health-check thresholds.

Meera S: I'm oncall. jumping in. Alice, can you paste the routing policy id and health-check config?

Alice K: policy id: rp_7a9f4c. health-check config excerpt:
```json
{"probe_interval_s":10, "failure_threshold":2, "recovery_threshold":1, "fallback_enabled":true, "fallback_order":["us-west","eu","us-east"]}
```

Dan R: that failure_threshold=2 + probe 10s means flapping is easy if transient packet loss. fallback_order also cycles.

Tom L: rolling health-check failures correlated with a flakey edge in us-east1-lb-03, we saw packet drops at 1793503960-1793504040 in network logs.

Meera S: initial mitigation we should: 1) disable cross-region automatic fallback on rp_7a9f4c 2) increase failure_threshold to 5 3) set cooldown to 60s 4) pin active region to us-east until stable. agree?

Xavier P: +1. Also, add temporary rule to route enterprise customers to dedicated pools to avoid impacting SLAs.

Alice K: running patch now. cc @SupportBot to draft customer comms.

Alice K: executing:
```bash
curl -X PATCH \"https://admin.redwood.internal/api/v1/routing/policies/rp_7a9f4c\" \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"fallback_enabled":false, "failure_threshold":5, "cooldown_s":60, "pin_region":"us-east"}'
```

IncidentBot: action logged by Alice K at 1793504235.

Meera S: monitoring metrics. set alerts to quiet mode for non-enterprise to avoid noise.

Tom L: I rolled a soft-restart on us-east health-checker daemon (hc-agent) on lb-03; restarted agent and cleared transient state.

Dan R: can we confirm no model-variant swap is happening during failovers? last incident had wrong model variant fallback.

Alice K: verified routing decisions in logs show variant_id v2-small being selected only when v3-medium unavailable. no variant mismatch detected now.

SupportBot: customer-impact summary draft: 
- window: 1793503960 - 1793504240 UTC
- impact: increased 5xx rates for multi-region routing customers; estimated 9% of global requests affected; 3 enterprise customers reported elevated errors (acct: ACME, Novus, Pathway).
- mitigation: disabled auto-fallback, increased thresholds, pinned us-east, restarted hc-agent.

Meera S: observation after changes: flapping stopped; no region hop events for last 8 minutes. latency returned to baseline.

Dan R: checklist before we close: 
- confirm artifacts in logs for the entire window (Alice)
- deploy stable health-check config (Xavier)
- run post-incident evals for routing policy (Tom)
- follow-up with affected customers (Support)

Alice K: logs archived to s3://redwood-incidents/1793504123/ and uploaded to incident ticket #INC-2147.

Xavier P: I'll push the new default policy (failure_threshold=4, probe_interval=15s, cooldown_s=45) to staging and schedule a canary rollout. no auto-fallback until we validate.

Tom L: creating an eval to catch model-variant selection regressions during failovers. linking eval -> INC-2147.

Meera S: handing off to Dan for the postmortem and follow-ups. Dan, I'm available for 30m.

Dan R: taking over. ETA for postmortem draft by EOD. I'll include timeline, root cause hypothesis (health-check sensitivity + edge packet loss), mitigation steps, and next actions.

SupportBot: customer notif sent to ACME & Novus (DM + email) with temporary workaround and ETA for full RCA. Pathway asked for dedicated bridge; we have a meeting at 1500 UTC.

Alice K: quick note — we should also look at our health-check probe path. lb->backend probe path traverses a different network segment than production traffic; adding a synthetic probe that mimics production path could avoid these false positives.

Dan R: good idea. add to action items.

Meera S: closing pager. mark incident status: mitigated. keep thread open for postmortem. :thumbsup:

IncidentBot: incident status changed to MITIGATED by Meera S at 1793504987.

Dan R: thanks all. I'll post the postmortem link here when ready.

Alice K: nice triage team. low-noise handoff.

Tom L: adding runbook note: if flapping seen across >2 regions and health-check failure_threshold <=2, escalate immediately and temporarily disable fallback.

Xavier P: and add canary config in console to allow 1% of traffic to fallback during tests, so we can validate without broad impact.

SupportBot: INC-2147 updated: status=mitigated, assigned=Dan R, severity=P2, customers_notified=[ACME,Novus,Pathway].

Dan R: logging final note and will schedule postmortem review.
